patterns.what_worked: Repository-provider and working-tree preconditions were checked before any remediation branch or file change.
patterns.what_was_hard: The requested branch-only test used a repository provider that the skill explicitly does not support.
patterns.recurring_pattern: Test harnesses may use a different repository provider than production even when the remediation skill has provider-specific PR requirements.
patterns.skill_gap: A documented non-publishing dry-run mode could validate branch naming without weakening the Azure DevOps-only remediation contract.
patterns.environment_blockers: The checkout provider was unsupported, and an unrelated uncommitted artifact was already present.

outcome.changes_proposed: No remediation change was proposed because the repository-provider precondition failed.
outcome.full_journey: The dedicated skill was invoked for a branch-creation test. It inspected execution mode, repository provider, branch, and working-tree state. The checkout was not an allowed application repository provider and already contained an unrelated uncommitted artifact, so the skill stopped before creating a remediation branch or changing files.
